entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 502 aa soluble bacterial protein; sequence analysis predicts molecular weight 55.4 kDa and pI 5.83.
Strongest homolog is reviewed Aquifex aeolicus O67377 Nnr: 45.0% identity, 96% query coverage, E-value 3.06e-122.
Predicted architecture includes YjeF_N domain at residues 27–174 and Carb_kinase domain at residues 232–471.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme performing NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration.
Potassium ion is a likely cofactor based on close reviewed homolog annotations; exact query-protein binding is inferred, not experimentally established.

entities.name: Aquifex aeolicus O67377
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot Nnr annotation: bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme.
Catalyzes epimerization of S/R NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H, producing AMP and phosphate.
Annotated EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136; binds one potassium ion per subunit.
Annotated biological processes include metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX metabolite repair
observations: Repairs hydrated NAD(P)H cofactors generated by enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration, restoring usable NADH/NADPH.

entities.name: Potassium cofactor
observations: Reviewed Nnr homologs bind one K+ ion per subunit; potassium dependence for the query is a homology-based inference.
